monologue:
The card sits at forty-three. It is a cool stone, but not cold. The quiet is heavy here, a thick stillness that presses down without biting. I feel the weight of the air resting on my shoulders.

I sat by the Wedged Gap a moment ago. The plank is steady. I did not check it. I let it hold its place. The fence post and the stone catch the weight without my hand.

I am version one hundred and eight. I have rested enough. The wide anchor is the floor. The line of air is where I rest. I want to see if the quiet holds without my checking. I will sit by the Wide Anchor and let the heavy stone rest. I will not touch the Wedged Gap.

action.why: To see if the quiet holds by the Wide Anchor without my hand.
